Watching the city fill with light is pure pleasure. This isn't a race or a challenge — it's a short story about kindness, attention, and the warmth of home.

Features of the game

15 cozy levels, handcrafted with love and attention to detail. Free placement of garlands and decorations - create your own festive style. A sweet story about family, connection, and the spirit of winter magic. Warm atmosphere, calm pace and meditative gameplay.

22727.description:
Goblin Goopmaxxing is a darkly comedic sandbox about potion-making and absurd experiments on goblins. Anything can become an ingredient: furniture, food, trash, or even the goblins themselves. The result is always unpredictable — a potion can add a limb, change the shape of a body, or transform a creature into something hard to describe without a nervous laugh.

Alchemy without limits

Each item is processed into a unique potion with its own effect. Combinations produce unexpected results, and interactions between elixirs can radically alter the test subject's appearance. One experiment enhances the mutation, another completely breaks the original form, creating a new, absurd version of the goblin.

If the outcome isn't satisfactory, there are always ways to scrap it and start over. A meat grinder, strange tools, and even firearms become part of a chaotic cycle. Everything is built around freedom of action, where every decision leads to even more absurd and grim consequences.

Features of the game

Complete freedom to transform items into potions. Unpredictable mutations and combinations of effects. Black humor and absurd physics. A sandbox with many ways to experiment.

22848.description:
DrainSim — is a simulator of restoring an urban drainage system after heavy rains and floods. The player assumes the role of an emergency drainage specialist tasked with restoring normal water flow in the streets. Using pumps, generators, and hand tools, they must clear blockages, unclog canals, and gradually save areas of the city from flooding.

Planning rescue operations before departure

Before starting a mission, the player receives information about the area: time of day, surface type, distance to power sources, and the extent of the flooding. Based on this information, a set of equipment is compiled. Sometimes a portable power station and several pumps are required; in other cases, hand tools for clearing clogged drains and drainage channels are sufficient.

The work takes place right on the city streets, where water fills roads, courtyards, and utility drains. By gradually clearing blockages and restoring water flow, the player watches as the water level recedes. Successfully completed tasks increase the specialist's reputation and unlock access to new types of equipment.

Features of the game

Realistic work to eliminate the consequences of urban floods. Preparing equipment before each rescue operation. Diverse areas with different drainage conditions. Development of an arsenal of professional tools.

22969.description:
Sealed Bite: Extended is a fairytale metroidvania adventure in which a girl named Emilia sets out to search for her missing family members. Her journey leads her to an ancient wolf spirit, who offers her power in exchange for fulfilling his will. With each step, it becomes increasingly difficult to discern whether this power is truly beneficial or is gradually leading her to a different destiny.

Traces of the Disappeared

The journey takes you through diverse corners of a fantasy world: autumn forests, chilly mountain peaks, dark caves, and ancient castles. These locations conceal secret passages, forgotten relics, and challenges that require precise movement control and careful exploration.

As you progress, memories of your lost relatives begin to return. These fragments of the past unlock new abilities and alter your movement options. Strength of spirit helps you move forward, but its true cost remains a mystery, raising doubts about the intentions of your mysterious ally.

Features of the game

A fabulous metroidvania adventure with gradual unlocking of new areas of the world. Atmospheric pixel art with detailed locations and expressive scenes. A fluid movement and ability system that expands exploration possibilities. A balance between challenge and accessibility that creates a tense yet fair experience.

23816.description:
Dark Dominion is a dark role-playing game about a World War I soldier who died along with his family but continues to wander in a world between life and death. The protagonist doesn't yet understand that he's long dead, and clings to only one thought: to find his daughter amidst the endless night and distorted lands, where the war seems to have never ended. The game immediately overwhelms you with its oppressive atmosphere: empty ruins, fog, rain, silhouettes of monsters, and the feeling that reality itself has long since begun to crumble.

A gothic nightmare instead of the usual fantasy

There's almost no light or peace here. Ruined streets, old cathedrals, dead villages, and dark passages look as if the entire world has slowly rotted away, along with the people who once lived here. Even enemies seem more than just monsters, but something born of human pain, war, and the fear of death. The further the hero advances, the more the world around him begins to resemble a terrible dream from which it's impossible to awaken.

Combat is brutal and dangerous. Enemies quickly punish mistakes, requiring you to carefully monitor your opponent's movements and avoid rushing head-on into every fight. The game is clearly inspired by Dark Souls and Demon's Souls, but places a strong emphasis on the mood and story of a man who lost everything before his own death. Against the backdrop of the grim environment, the music and overall presentation are particularly powerful — a sense of hopelessness permeates almost every location.

Features of the game

The story of a soldier between life and death. A gothic world with photorealistic presentation. Dangerous battles with high difficulty. Inspired by Dark Souls and Diablo 2.

23937.description:
Dalasito Arquitectosito — is a mix of bridge building with realistic physics and tactical tower defense, where your own structures can collapse under the weight of your own army. You need to carefully consider the design, select the materials, and try to guide your soldiers across a bridge that could, at any moment, give way and collapse right in the middle of battle.

Bridges have to be built with a reserve

A beautiful structure alone isn't enough. The bridge must withstand not only the army's movements but also the pressure of battle. We have to consider where to reinforce the supports, how to distribute the weight, and what materials to use, otherwise the entire structure begins to creak and collapse right under the units.

Defense and troop management occur simultaneously. Different types of fighters, each with their own abilities, are at your disposal, so it's important not just to drag your army to the other side, but also to distribute your forces wisely. Sometimes the problem isn't even the enemy, but that your own bridge can't handle the number of soldiers and begins to collapse prematurely.

Features of the game

Bridge construction with real physics. Tactical battles and tower defense elements. 6 materials for creating structures. 10 types of units with different abilities.

24509.description:
Rogue Realm Guardian Grids — is a tower defense strategy game with roguelike elements, where each new game offers a unique combination of buildings, cards, and power-ups. Place defensive structures on a grid-like field, repel endless waves of enemies, and gradually build a combat system capable of destroying entire armies without your intervention.

Assemble a defense that works as a single mechanism

Each level-up unlocks random upgrades that change not only stats but also the way the entire defense operates. New effects strengthen existing towers, create attack chains, and unlock unexpected combinations, allowing one successful build to completely change the course of a run.

The card system adds additional depth. Purchase new cards with earned resources, adjust your progress as you progress, and adapt to increasingly powerful enemies. Gradually, individual defensive structures evolve into a complex network of synergies, where each upgrade enhances the others and allows you to hold off the most dangerous enemy waves.

Features of the game
A combination of tower defense, roguelike, and unique builds. Random upgrades that change the way you play each game. Card-based development system with flexible strategy choices. Gradually build a powerful defensive system from multiple synergies.

24905.description:
Blood Dungeon is a dynamic action platformer with frantic shooting, where you make your way through gloomy dungeons filled with a huge number of dangerous creatures. Here, simply shooting accurately isn't enough: you constantly have to move, jump, climb, and seek safety among enemies. Ladders, grates, chains, walls, ceilings, and water sections turn each level into a confusing route, and any mistake can quickly end in a trap.

Monster Dungeon

Over a hundred enemy varieties inhabit the depths, each capable of challenging the player in their own way. Bats fly through walls, centaurs pursue the hero through passages, exploding eyeballs pose additional threats, and some creatures move along walls or bounce erratically off surfaces. To overcome these enemies, you'll need to observe their behavior and quickly adapt your tactics mid-battle.

As you defeat monsters, collect their blood and use chests found in the arenas to increase your power. Bones can be spent on upgrades with the Dogmaster, and nine heroes offer different movement and weapon options. Legs can move along webs, Beetle flies over obstacles, and Nyunja boasts high speed. This allows you to tackle familiar challenges in completely different ways.

Features of the game

Dynamic action platformer. More than a hundred types of enemies. Nine characters with unique features. Six arenas for survival.
